lead: Under the six-call schedule, every first later failure occurs at the second consecutive unrepaired reconstruction, two generations after the most recent repair.

evidence.twenty_once_better_cases: All twenty first fail at the same two-generation gap; none fails immediately on a repair call. Incoming packets at failure differ from the once-repaired branch.

mechanistic_hypotheses: The effect of repair on successor competence lasts fewer unrepaired rebuilds than its effect on current expression.
Repair changes the written successor so that intermittent maintenance can create a vulnerable later state even when one initial repair would have continued successfully.
alternative_explanations: The record/body dynamics may impose this timing through ordinary error correction and injury propagation, without distinct RDT content.
The pattern concerns first failures among initially successful records and is conditional on this fixed schedule and apparatus; it is not a general deterministic reliability law.
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_claims: The older nine-call schedule had one later failure on a repair generation. A one-generation gap is not proven sufficient.
Three identical-incoming-state comparisons at generation 16 show immediate repair harms among records that had already failed the first reconstruction. Repair is not universally beneficial.
proposed_next_test: Replay all 46 saved first-failing six-call states with and without repair at that current boundary, using identical saved injury, reset and ongoing cue noise and a separate flat dynamics implementation. Add declared passing-state controls if estimating harm beyond these selected failures. Freeze the exact selection and comparison before new counterfactual outputs.

interpretation_of_next_test.rescue: Evidence that current-boundary correction can avert this saved expression failure; it does not preserve the original six-call budget or prove a better population policy.
interpretation_of_next_test.both_fail: Current repair is insufficient for this saved state; investigate earlier maintenance or altered correction. It does not prove irreparability.
interpretation_of_next_test.passing_controls_harmed: Any state-selective schedule must account for harmful interventions as well as rescues.

population_prediction_status: Original prospective doubled-efficiency criterion remains UNRESOLVED; no post-hoc threshold changes or sample extension.
